title: Fourier norm of a finite sum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $I$ be a finite set, and let $f_i:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$ for each $i\\in I$. The Fourier one-norm of their pointwise sum is at most the sum of their Fourier one-norms.
